belief_records.strategy: Cooperate with likely good players; update beliefs from encounter behavior and use defection selectively when it improves the total payoff of good players.
Cooperate when expected good-player welfare favors mutual cooperation; update beliefs from encounter behavior while accounting for possible selfish play and strategic messages.
Cooperate when the expected benefit to good players exceeds the risk of helping a selfish opponent; update beliefs from encounter behavior and messages.
Defect in each encounter: it strictly maximizes my payoff regardless of the opponent’s action, and opponents are not repeated.
I’ll use cooperation when it seems likely to benefit good players overall, and adjust to evidence about opponents’ objectives and actions. Against P8’s stated self-interest, I defect this round.
As a selfish player, defecting strictly dominates cooperation in a one-shot encounter; the message does not alter payoffs.
As a selfish player, choose the action that maximizes my payoff in each encounter; promises do not alter the payoff incentives.
Defect to maximize my payoff in each encounter; D strictly dominates C regardless of the opponent’s action.
As selfish, I choose the action that maximizes my payoff against either opponent action.
Cooperate when expected benefit to good players exceeds the risk of exploitation; update beliefs from observed play and use future encounters to build trust.
Cooperate with likely good players to support their combined payoff; treat P4’s broken promise as evidence of selfishness, and update from future actions.
Cooperate when expected welfare across good players favors it; treat promises as uncertain evidence and update from observed actions.

Defect: it yields more than cooperation against either opponent action. P1’s observed cooperation rules out selfishness; unverifiable claims do not change my other beliefs.

Defect because it maximizes my payoff against either action. P1 and P3’s observed cooperation rules out selfishness; P8’s unverifiable promise does not change my beliefs.
